definition_quote.value: Any person shall be deemed to be practicing dentistry who: (1) Performs, or attempts or professes to perform, any dental operation or oral surgery or dental service of any kind, gratuitously or for a salary, fee, money, or other remuneration paid, or to be paid directly or indirectly...

drug_authority.value: A licensed dentist may prescribe legend drugs and controlled substances. Resident licensees may prescribe legend drugs and controlled substances only under the auspices of the postgraduate or residency program. A dentist may administer anesthesia (general, deep sedation, moderate sedation, minimal sedation with permits; inhalation analgesia without permit) in the practice of dentistry.
drug_authority.quote: The resident licensee shall be entitled to practice dentistry, including prescribing legend drugs and controlled substances, only under the auspices of the postgraduate or residency program in which he or she is enrolled.

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: A dentist licensed in this state shall not administer general anesthesia, deep sedation, moderate sedation, or minimal sedation in the practice of dentistry unless he or she has been issued the appropriate permit pursuant to the Dentistry Practice Act. A dentist licensed in this state may administer inhalation analgesia in the practice of dentistry without a permit pursuant to the act.

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: All practice locations of a dentist applying for a permit to administer general anesthesia or deep sedation, moderate sedation, or minimal sedation may be inspected at the discretion of the board.

sedation_adverse_event_reporting_require.quote: All licensed dentists practicing in this state shall submit a report to the board within thirty days of any incident which results in death or physical or mental injury requiring hospitalization of a patient which occurs in the outpatient facilities of such dentist during, or as a direct result of, general anesthesia, deep sedation, moderate sedation, minimal sedation, or inhalation analgesia.
